multiplicity.method: paired seed-cluster, sum stratified matchup means; normal CI95; Bonferroni simultaneous95 across all main comparisons in both independent seed phases
multiplicity.zeroVarianceCorrection: When empirical SE=0, preserve normal interval in normalApproximation and use conservative bounded seed-cluster Hoeffding interval; no evidence of equivalence from identical observed outcomes

metricNotes.ownActionTurns: prep/attack controller decisions, unique turn and level
metricNotes.ownExecutedTurns: non-pass prep/attack/chain action selected, unique turn and level
metricNotes.defenseActionTurns: defense decision possible, unique opponent turn and own level
metricNotes.defenseExecutedTurns: defense card selected, unique opponent turn and own level
metricNotes.buffThreshold: resolved AT/DF arithmetic removing only +200 while chosen actions fixed; not causal win contribution
metricNotes.gaugeHandLegalLoss: actual hidden hand used only by observation, not by selector
metricNotes.gaugePublicLegalLoss: fixed deck pool weighted DP availability; selector uses public gauge and known list only
metricNotes.noLegalAttackTurns: unblocked own battle phase with positive-DP non-green hand card(s) but no legal positive-DP normal attack; no-hand and hospital excluded
metricNotes.swapCorrection: New-Yagyu environments: unchanged Lv2 returns were captured by charReturnByLevel but omitted by selection action counter; supplement Lv2 swapCards/actions from actual returned count (max1 per event). Lv3-5 unchanged.
metricNotes.swapOpportunities: nonempty hand during a character swap selection
metricNotes.oldCharMill: actual Lv4/5 Katsuragi or old Hibari Lv5 mill in character hook
metricNotes.levelArrays: indices Lv1..Lv5; reached = any entry in game; multiple levels may have actions in same turn
metricNotes.charDrawByLevel: Lv3-5 target hooks fully observed; Asuka Lv2 engine-internal draw not instrumented and masked null, not zero
metricNotes.behaviorMetrics: descriptive only; post-intervention mediators not isolated causal contributions
metricNotes.endByOutcome: n and deck/hand/turn are sums by win/loss; divide by n for conditional means
metricNotes.nameHistograms: totals dictionaries are event counts; means dictionaries are counts per game
